title: Used Habitica for 7 years, can no longer recommend it
body:
As the title says, I have been using Habitica for 7 years - 7.5 years to be correct. 
While it’s a fairly good task manager, the lack of new features and bug fixes has made me use it less and less. What kept me there was the community, but that community is now slowly disintegrating, as all the volunteer mods have been removed. Staff has taken over moderation, and it would be a pity to say that they are even doing the bare minimum - because they certainly are not. 
So if you are looking for a supportive community, I would look elsewhere. 

Additionally, long term users and volunteer contributors are now being told off for flagging triggering content. This never happened with the volunteer mod team. It has not been possible to get clear guidelines from staff for 1.5 months. 

If you are just looking for a basic, free task manager, sure. But be aware that there have been app-breaking bugs for a long time, that seems like is no priority to fix. Just as an example, the app frequently crashes if you click any of your notifications leading to a party or guild. It is super annoying.
author: Lalaith93

title: A great To-do list with some fun on top
body:
Habitica is essentially a To-do list with a very non-intrusive RPG game slapped on top of it. The division of lists into three separate categories (Habits, Dailies and To-Dos) makes a lot of sense. It's intuitive to use and fun to look at. You can make little encouraging notes under your tasks and set difficulties (this is mostly for the previously mentioned RPG game part of it).

It has a bit of jank here and there, I've experienced some slow load, especially on the daily reset, but it's obviously being worked on AND it's a fully featured To-do app, no monthly premiums for "Habitica Gold Features".

I would highly recommend Habitica, even if you aren't a huge video game liker. The UI makes sense, it's fun to look at and apparently there's a large and supportive community in the chat section of the game.

title: Several levels of awesome
body: This app is the most fun goals and to-do management I have seen. It tracks good and bad habits, repeatable goals and to-do lists. Besides the activities you supply, you can join friends in groups for accountability. The better you manage to complete your real life daily goals, the better the group makes out on shared bossfights. The community - through optional multiple guilds - supply inspiration too  with challenges for different interests that you may choose to join. Challenges adds a set of habits, dailies and to- dos. I am most happy about having joined the Habitica numbers, looking forward to see future developement on the app.

The Habitica app is an astonishingly helpful tool to keep track of your life and accompanies the website well!

Add an excellent support and attentive and kind developers, and you've got pretty much everything you need.
